system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform these two different actions simultaneously: agrimarket_search_listings and agrimarket_get_listing_details. Here are my details: my listing_id is AGRIMKT-LST-12000002.

function.name: agrimarket_search_listings
function.description: Searches available crop listings by commodity, location, quality, and price range. Requires session_token. Does NOT place orders. Fails if no listings match. Returns only 'active' listings.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

function.name: agrimarket_get_listing_details
function.description: Retrieves full details of a specific listing including seller info, quantity, price, and status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify listing. Fails if listing_id is invalid or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

listing_id.description: Unique identifier of a crop listing.
